journey.title: Our Journey
journey.paragraph1: Established in 1987, Radhakishan Hospital has been serving patients and families with honesty, dedication, and hard work for decades. From its foundation in Kurukshetra, Haryana, the hospital has continued to expand its healthcare services for patients across Haryana and beyond. With changing healthcare needs, Radhakishan Hospital continues to embrace new technologies, modern medical practices, new skills, improved systems, and evolving developments in healthcare to enhance the overall patient experience and delivery of care.
journey.paragraph2: We believe that a hospital is not only about treatment but also about creating a clean, safe, comfortable, and respectful environment. Our team takes care of the hospital surroundings and makes every effort to guide patients and attendants properly, communicate with them courteously, and support them throughout their healthcare journey.
journey.paragraph3: Our commitment remains simple — to serve with integrity, evolve with healthcare, and care for every patient with respect.

booking.question: How do I book an OPD appointment?
booking.answer: OPD appointments start at 9:00 AM in the morning. You can book an appointment by calling our OPD number at +91 72060 29516.

timings.question: What are your OPD timings?
timings.answer: OPD timings are from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM and from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM. OPD remains closed on Sunday. OPD appointments start at 9:00 AM in the morning.

emergency.question: Is emergency care available 24/7?
emergency.answer: Yes. Our Emergency Department is available 24/7. For emergency assistance, call +91 1744 270516.

insurance.question: Do you provide cashless insurance facilities?
insurance.answer: Yes. Cashless facility is available for the following insurance/healthcare schemes and providers: Genins India Insurance TPA Limited, Star Health Insurance, Reliance Health Insurance, Niva Bupa Health Insurance, Tata AIG, Care Health Insurance, HDFC ERGO Health Insurance Plans, Aditya Birla Capital, Ayushman Bharat, Cigna Health Life Insurance, Heritage Health, Medi Assist Insurance TPA Pvt. Ltd., Paramount Health Insurance, IFFCO Tokio General Insurance, Chola MS General Insurance, Universal Sompo, FHPL Insurance (Beyond Insurance), and ECHS.

contact.question: How can I contact the hospital?
contact.answer: For OPD-related queries and appointments, call +91 72060 29516. For emergency assistance, call +91 1744 270516.

location.question: Where is Radhakishan Hospital located?
location.answer: Radhakishan Hospital is located at Jyoti Nagar, Thanesar, Kurukshetra, Haryana 136118.
